# Megatron-DeepSpeed dftracer Pipeline — Reproduction Package

This folder is a **self-contained** reproduction of the `megatron_deepspeed/20260726_185517` dftracer session. It requires no access to the original session workspace.

## 1. Copy this folder somewhere writable

```bash
cp -r final_report/ /path/to/scratch/megatron_deepspeed_repro/
cd /path/to/scratch/megatron_deepspeed_repro/
```

## 2. Edit `config.ini`

Set `WORKSPACE_ROOT=/path/to/scratch/megatron_deepspeed_repro`. This is the only file where a real path goes — every script under `scripts/` sources `scripts/lib_load_config.sh`, which reads `config.ini`.

## 3. Install dependencies and build

```bash
bash scripts/install.sh
```

Rebuilds the Megatron-DeepSpeed app, ROCm-torch environment, apex, and dftracer (FUNCTION mode) as this session did.

## 4. Run every case from this session, in order

```bash
bash scripts/run_all.sh <flux-alloc-id>
```

Drives, in order: the baseline (gloo/ZeRO-0/fp16, 145.4 sps expected), `run_opt_nccl.sh` (gloo->nccl, ~147 sps), `run_opt_zero1.sh` (ZeRO-1, ~116 sps regression), `run_opt_bf16.sh`/`run_opt_bf16b.sh` (bf16, ~106-108 sps regression), the compute agent's replicated base20/bf16/hipblaslt/rocblas study, and the `prebuild_cache.sh`/`warm_jit.sh` pre-warming steps used before every timed run (iteration 1 is always excluded from reported throughput as JIT warmup).

## 5. Check it worked

Compare your reproduced steady-state samples/sec against `REPORT.md` Section 7b (N-Way Comparator Table): baseline ~142-146 sps, nccl variant within ~1-2% of baseline, ZeRO-1/bf16 noticeably lower (~15-27% regression). "Within noise" means within the cross-replicate CV band (<1.3% within-run, ~4% cross-replicate).

## Validation status

This package has **not** been validated end-to-end by re-running `scripts/run_all.sh` in an isolated scratch directory (no fresh allocation was available at report-assembly time).

### Diagnostic / debugging scripts (`scripts/`, collected for provenance — NOT part of the core reproduction path)

These were exploratory scripts used during STEP 7's ~10-attempt baseline-debugging process (DDP rendezvous, hostname resolution, launcher world-size-1 trap) and during environment setup (apex build, torchvision ABI check). They are retained here for provenance/troubleshooting reference only; `scripts/run_all.sh` does not invoke them, and a fresh reproduction does not need to run them if `scripts/run_baseline.sh` succeeds directly:

`run_check_env.sh`, `run_check_env2.sh`, `run_build_apex.sh`, `run_verify_apex.sh`, `run_check_torch.sh`, `run_try_torchvision.sh`, `run_verify_tv.sh`, `run_uninstall_tv.sh`, `run_run_slice.sh`, `run_run_baseline_training.sh`, `run_run_diagnostic_8rank.sh`, `run_run_diagnostic_4rank_nccl.sh`, `run_check_hostnames.sh`, `run_run_2rank_connectivity_test.sh`, `run_test_flux_mpi_env.sh`, `run_run_ddp_pmi_direct.sh`, `run_run_fixed_ddp_test.sh`, `run_run_ddp_with_ifname.sh`, `run_run_ddp_with_hsi_ip.sh`, `run_run_ddp_hsn_ip_final.sh`, `run_run_ddp_single_node.sh`, `run_run_ddp_torchrun.sh`, `run_torchrun_wrapper.sh`, `run_install_torchrun_hpc.sh`, `run_dryrun_wrapper.sh`, `run_allreduce_wrapper.sh`, `run_probe_wrapper.sh`.

If you hit a DDP rendezvous hang reproducing the baseline, `run_check_hostnames.sh` -> `run_run_2rank_connectivity_test.sh` -> `run_run_ddp_hsn_ip_final.sh` is the order this session used to isolate the fix (see `REPORT.md` §3 dftracer-tracer / §9 Lessons Learned).
